target_customer: Teams and small businesses building internal AI products and apps
problem: Teams ship AI that does not work well and pilots stall; prompting alone does not give shared context between people, agents and code.
business_model: SaaS AI app builder for teams, pricing not found

founders.name: Sruthi Viswanathan
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; named to 100 Women in AI (2025).

competitors.name: Lovable
competitors.what: AI app builder with multiplayer workspaces from version 2.0
competitors.traction_then: Large user base per comparison articles

competitors.name: Bolt.new
competitors.what: StackBlitz AI app builder, per-seat team plans

competitors.name: Replit
competitors.what: Cloud editor with AI agent and team plans

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many tools, shared context and deployment is standard engineering, with hard parts in reliability.

defensibility.rationale: AI app builders are copyable and large rivals already offer multiplayer features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals already shipped multiplayer workspaces by 2026.

market_need_then: AI app builders were a fast-growing category with many 2026 comparison articles; the company claims 12 live businesses and 50k+ usage hits, unverified.

identity.mascot_or_character: Spider mascot with silk and web imagery per the website
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and playful, 'Not ideas. Not prototypes. The real thing.'

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct mascot but a generic name and no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Deep Interactions is an early company in a crowded AI app builder market with a founder who has an Oxford DPhil and research roles at Google and NAVER LABS. No outcome events were found and funding is unconfirmed, so its outcome is unknown.
notes: FundedIQ lists a $500K pre-seed in June 2026 with no named lead; single aggregator, so no round recorded. Team size conflicts (YC page 6, search snippet 4). Competitor info comes from 2026 comparison articles, not sources dated at founding. No source explains the name or the spider mascot.
